page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.c1 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network configurations do not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Because there is no local storage, all storage requirements must be met via network-attached storage options.

With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to memory, the ecs.c1.small is structured for compute-heavy tasks that do not require large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource sharing. This profile is suitable for compute-intensive workloads, batch processing, and lightweight web serving where memory demands are minimal.
